mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.username, u.nickname, s.scale_name, r.level FROM psy_follow_up f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN psy_test_record r ON f.record_id = r.record_id LEFT JOIN psy_scale s ON r.scale_id = s.scale_id WHERE 1=1 AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = #{status} ORDER BY f.follow_date DESC, f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.*, u.username, u.nickname, s.scale_name, r.level FROM psy_follow_up f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN psy_test_record r ON f.record_id = r.record_id LEFT JOIN psy_scale s ON r.scale_id = s.scale_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psy_follow_up (user_id, record_id, doctor_id, follow_date, follow_type, status, symptom_score, doctor_note, next_follow_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordId}, #{doctorId}, #{followDate}, #{followType}, #{status}, #{symptomScore}, #{doctorNote}, #{nextFollowDate})
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.username, u.nickname, s.scale_name, r.level FROM psy_follow_up f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN psy_test_record r ON f.record_id = r.record_id LEFT JOIN psy_scale s ON r.scale_id = s.scale_id WHERE f.status = '待随访' AND f.follow_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY f.follow_date ASC
